blocked.name: addressable
blocked.needs: `group` on 17 placements (front 11, rear 6); `rel-pos` on 69 placements (front 57, rear 12)

gaps.wanted: an `attrs.power` section; an `attrs.thermal` section (profile `optical` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on port groups channels, xc - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
ports the Nautobot exporter recognises - each port placement needs `attrs.media` and `attrs.speed` in a combination it maps - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.channel-plan: silkscreen - channels alternate in pairs between rows, 921/922 top then 923/924 bottom, continuing to 960
provenance.column-grid: top and bottom rows agreed across all 23 columns, so one averaged grid is used and the drawing jitter discarded
provenance.markings: photo - IEC 60825 laser hazard triangles in the gap between the two port blocks, matching the 34D
provenance.port-pairing: each LC duplex adapter carries two connection points about 6.6mm apart, one per fiber; adapters recovered by pairing those
provenance.port-positions: stencil ShapeSheet connection points, which Visio stores as fractions of shape width/height and therefore survive without the drawing scale. Resolved against the 19-inch rack width the master is drawn at.
provenance.psu-orientation: photo - both modules are fitted the same way round, fan inboard of the inlet, so the C14 sits at the far right on PSU-2 and inboard on PSU-1. They are not mirrored
provenance.psu-part: label - Gospower G1251-0550WNA, P/N CRPS0550-AH, and the fan sticker reads 550W Platinum CRPS. So the module is a standard CRPS 1U part at 73.5 x 40 x 185, not the 84mm-wide estimate taken from the racked photo, and both bays sit flush to the chassis edges
provenance.rear-layout: photo IMG_2181 of racked DCP-R units - PSU with integrated fan and C14 inlet at each end, mirrored; honeycomb vent panel across the centre; management block right of centre. Block positions are approximate to about 3mm - the photo has uncorrected perspective and partial cable occlusion, so it fixes the structure and order but not exact millimetres
provenance.rear-mgmt-block: stencil master dcp-r-rear, which is orthographic - a 2x2 ganged RJ45 shell (ETH 2 / ETH 4 over ETH 1 / ETH 3), ESD warning, Tx and Rx LEDs, an ETH 5 SFP cage and a recessed RESET button
provenance.side-top-bottom: IMG_2188 shows the lid, so these now carry the real finish - a light silver body with the black front panel wrapping about 12.7mm (half an inch) back along every face. Still no vents, screws or lid labels - the photo shows the finish and the panel depth but not those details, so they are left out rather than invented
provenance.tx-rx-boxes: photo - every optical port carries a boxed Tx/Rx pair between its name and the adapter, split by a divider, reversed on the bottom row
provenance.y-scale: this master is drawn 46.0mm tall against a 45mm chassis, so y was scaled by 45/46.0. The 34D master needed no such correction - a reminder that masters in one stencil are not all drawn to the same scale
